sites.name: Shackleton Rim
sites.notes: IAU Gazetteer Feature 5450, center solution 1 (planetographic, +East, -180 to 180). This is the Shackleton crater center, not a rim point or an official Artemis landing-site coordinate. M2 approved interpreting these published coordinates in the project MOON_ME frame; the Gazetteer page does not itself specify that frame.

sites.name: Malapert Massif
sites.notes: NASA lists Malapert Massif as an Artemis III candidate region (Release 22-089). Coordinates are IAU Gazetteer Feature 16338, Mons Malapert center solution 1 (planetographic, +East, -180 to 180), not the crater Malapert or the official candidate-region center. M2 approved interpreting these published coordinates in the project MOON_ME frame; the Gazetteer page does not itself specify that frame.
